starting_question: Does co-migration with cytochrome bd establish a subunit role, or does YhcB participate in envelope growth/division?

actual_observations.observation: Blue-native co-migration motivated a third-subunit proposal; subsequent purification reported normal oxidase assembly/heme/kinetics without YhcB and no stable YhcB association.
Abnormal FtsZ pattern: WT 2% of 675 cells versus deletion 12.2% of 793 cells; reported uncertainty retained in raw extract.
rodZ and mrcB transposon fitness logFC are negative; fabF positive. fabF and mlaA are suppressor candidates under both vancomycin and SDS/EDTA selections.

annotation_consequence: Supports participation in coordinated envelope growth and division. Co-migration did not establish oxidase membership; exact direct molecular connector remains unresolved.
experiment_dependence: Published cell imaging, bacterial two-hybrid, mutagenesis, chemical genetics, lipid/envelope analyses; our work extracts their records.
reasoning_reported_vs_reconstructed: The cited authors report the experiments and infer the cellular participation. My source selection and the compact annotation boundary are retrospective reconstruction; I did not perform their experiments.
verification_scope: 2021 JBC and PLOS full Results/tables inspected; original 2005 indexed primary text inspected; 2006 negative result checked at primary abstract only. Six original PLOS spreadsheets downloaded; S4/S6 rows parsed.

gene_protein: YlbF, YmcA, YaaT (one linked complex case)
organism: Bacillus subtilis 3610; Staphylococcus aureus comparative test
starting_question: Do developmental phenotypes reflect direct phosphorelay activation, or RNA processing through RNase Y?

actual_observations.observation: SinR increases with little promoter effect; lowering SinR translation repairs biofilm formation. RNase Y association and cggR-gapA processing support an RNA-level route.
A separate group reports phosphorelay bypass and strain-dependent effects and disputes sinR stabilization.

cggR/gapA 5-prime end at NC_000964.3:3482769 has WT 341.61 normalized signal, versus deletion ylbF 7.52, ymcA 8.93, rny 2.39. rnpB mature 3-prime signal remains high in Y-complex mutants while reduced in rny.

annotation_consequence: Supports an RNase Y accessory role in selected transcript maturation. Do not equate it with all RNase Y activity or declare the historical direct-phosphorelay disagreement resolved.
experiment_dependence: Genetics, reporters, Northern blots, protein association, membrane flotation, Rend-seq and exonuclease treatment are authors experiments; live work reads deposited tracks.

starting_question: Which cellular defect explains pleiotropic loss of a conserved protein without an established cellular role?

actual_observations.observation: Deletion changes rRNA termini, ribosome profiles and translational fidelity; interactions with rnc, rnr and pnp connect the phenotype to RNA metabolism.
Reconstituted 70S particles become degradation substrates when the 30S subunit is mutant-derived; a mutant 50S plus normal 30S does not suffice.

annotation_consequence: Supports rRNA maturation and defective-ribosome quality-control participation; a pleiotropic stress phenotype alone would not specify that role.
experiment_dependence: rRNA end mapping, mutant genetics, purified ribosomes/RNases and reconstitution; not feasible as live software-only validation.

starting_question: Does a YbeY homolog share all RNA effects seen in E. coli, and why is it essential here?

annotation_consequence: Supports 16S 3-prime maturation and a genetic relationship to ribosome turnover; homologous cellular effects are narrower than those reported for E. coli YbeY.

annotation_consequence: Supports an ancillary Sec-associated role overlapping the periplasmic folding network; direct chaperone activity or a universal substrate handoff mechanism is not established.

gene_protein: LetB (YebT) with LetA; one system case
starting_question: What cellular task is served by a long repeated MCE-domain protein?

actual_observations.observation: Structure shows a periplasm-length hydrophobic tunnel. Lipid crosslinking places phosphate-bearing material inside it. Length and pore-loop mutants lose ability to complement a sensitized pqiAB/letAB detergent phenotype.

annotation_consequence: Supports lipid-associated envelope maintenance and a tunnel-transport model. Physiology, lipid contact and shape are convergent; this paper does not directly measure net lipid transport through the tunnel.
experiment_dependence: Cryo-EM, engineered truncations, in-cell crosslinking and genetic complementation.

starting_question: What essential function underlies an envelope phenotype previously associated with cardiolipin transport?

actual_observations.observation: Suppressors map to lpxC/lapB; LpxC overproduction permits complete yejM deletion. Translation-shutoff blots show excessive LpxC loss without YejM. A polar recruitment assay detects LapB association.

annotation_consequence: Supports regulation of LPS synthesis via LpxC turnover. Cardiolipin binding/abundance effects alone did not establish a transporter role.

starting_question: Does antibiotic sensitivity arise from failed lipid-A modification or a different envelope process?

annotation_consequence: Supports redundant participation in envelope lipid homeostasis and GPL trafficking. The authors transport interpretation exceeds what antibiotic sensitivity alone shows.

starting_question: Which SOS-induced gene inhibits division in a bacterium without a SulA homolog?

actual_observations.observation: dinR loss induces the neighboring yneA-yneB-ynzC operon. Deleting that operon suppresses filamentation; inducible YneA alone reinduces elongation, whereas YneB or YnzC do not. Operon deletion reduces mitomycin-C-induced elongation.

annotation_consequence: Supports an SOS division-inhibitor role. The 2003 FtsZ-localization effect did not establish direct binding to FtsZ.
experiment_dependence: Regulatory mutant/Northern, double-deletion epistasis, inducible expression and microscopy.
reasoning_reported_vs_reconstructed: The cited authors report the experiments and infer the cellular participation. My source selection and the compact annotation boundary are retrospective reconstruction; I did not perform their experiments.
verification_scope: Primary publisher full Results inspected, including whole-operon deletion, separate gene re-expression and negative YneB/YnzC controls. The newer 2026 FtsW mechanism paper remains an abstract-only unexamined follow-up; do not treat the 2003 FtsZ inference as current direct mechanism.
